name: openpixo/feature-gamepad
title: Gamepad support
description: Adds controller input through an action layer, analog movement with deadzones, menu navigation and device-aware button prompts.

useCase.query:
Add gamepad support to this {{engine.id}} game covering: {{scope}}. Button labels: {{glyphs}}.

Requirements:
- Gameplay reads actions, not devices. Godot: add joypad events (left stick, D-pad, face buttons, Start) to the existing `InputMap` actions in `project.godot`, give stick actions a 0.2 deadzone, and use `Input.get_vector` for analog movement. Phaser: enable `input: { gamepad: true }` in the game config and add one `src/input/controls.ts` layer that merges keyboard and gamepad (standard mapping) into named actions with a radial deadzone.
- Menus work without a mouse: focus starts on the first control, the D-pad and stick move focus, the accept button activates and the back button returns (Godot: focus neighbours and `grab_focus()`; Phaser: an explicit focus index per menu).
- On-screen prompts switch between keyboard and gamepad labels based on the last device used.
- Connecting and disconnecting a pad is handled at runtime; a disconnect during play pauses the game.
- Keyboard and mouse controls keep working exactly as before.
- Automated verification cannot press real buttons, so after verify list the manual gamepad checks the user should run.

Finish by running `pixo game verify --steps check,build,run --screenshot --json`. Fix every failing step and run it again; do not re-run unchanged code. Open the screenshot and confirm the change is actually on screen with no error overlay or blank canvas. Report what passed, what failed, and what could not run.
